column1: **Nx:** Number of discretised domain elements in the x (zonal) direction
**Ny:** Number of discretised domain elements in the y (meridional) direction
**Nz:** Number of discretised domain elements in the z (vertical) direction
**Nh:** Number of halo cells to be used (dependent on largest stencil extent)
**d_xi:** Computational domain fixed resolution in the 'i' direction
**d_eta:** Computational domain fixed resolution in the 'j' direction
**d_zeta:** Computational domain fixed resolution in the 'k' direction
**coordHorizHalos:** Switch to setup coordiante halos as periodic=1 or gradient-following=0
**topoFile:** A file containing topography (surface elevation in meters ASL)
**verticalDeformSwitch:** Switch to use vertical coordinate deformation 0=off; 1=on
